segments.sn3.7:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn3.7:1.3: “idhāhaṃ, bhante, aḍḍakaraṇe [atthakaraṇe (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] nisinno passāmi khattiyamahāsālepi brāhmaṇamahāsālepi gahapatimahāsālepi aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavittūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsante.
segments.sn3.7:1.5: ‘alaṃ dāni me aḍḍakaraṇena, bhadramukho dāni aḍḍakaraṇena paññāyissatī’”ti.
segments.sn3.7:2.1: “(Evametaṃ, mahārāja, evametaṃ mahārāja!)[() sī. pī. potthakesu natthi]
segments.sn3.7:2.2: Yepi te, mahārāja, khattiyamahāsālā brāhmaṇamahāsālā gahapatimahāsālā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūtajātarūparajatā pahūtavittūpakaraṇā pahūtadhanadhaññā kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsanti;
segments.sn3.7:2.3: tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā”ti.

lines: Tattha paṭhamataraṃ lañjaṃ gahetvā nisinnā amaccā assāmikepi sāmike kariṃsu.
“mayhaṃ tāva pathavissarassa sammukhāpete evaṃ karonti, parammukhā kiṃ nāma na karissanti?
Paññāyissati dāni viṭaṭūbho senāpati sakena rajjena, kiṃ mayhaṃ evarūpehi lañjakhādakehi musāvādīhi saddhiṃ ekaṭṭhāne nisajjāyā”ti cintesi.
Yathā macchā oḍḍitaṃ kuminaṃ pavisantā na jānanti, evaṃ sattā kilesakāmena vatthukāmaṃ vītikkamantā na jānantīti attho.
Yasmā kāmanimittaṃ satto sampajānamusā bhāsati, tasmā kāmā tassa patiṭṭhā paccayo kāraṇanti āha “kāmahetū”tiādi.
Bhadramukha sīsena viṭaṭubhaṃ bhadropacārena upacaratīti attho, vinicchayo karīyati etthāti aḍḍakaraṇaṃ, vinicchayaṭṭhānaṃ.
